output.summary: Turnover rise is real: payroll-reconciled, not a PeopleCore artifact. It is much larger than in-state peers (+19 points against +5). The step up began in March 2026, when the Saturday policy took effect at all branches, before ShiftWise went live in April. Exit-survey schedule complaints rose from 19% to 48%. Pay is cited at similar rates in both years, and the bank has no current market benchmark. Vacancies drive the VAC-COVER overtime. The manager-of-record field is stale, so manager-based discipline would punish the wrong people. No branch-level or ShiftWise comparison exists yet. Do not approve the 15% raise or the bonus withholding now. Get the branch separation data, the ShiftWise pre/post comparison and the pay benchmark first. A targeted pay adjustment can still go in through the January cycle.
